name: agent-feedback-monorepo
description: Leave comments on your live app. Your coding agent resolves them.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:examples
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w @agent-feedback/example-vite && npm run build -w @agent-feedback/example-next
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @agent-feedback/core && npm run build -w @agent-feedback/react && npm run build -w @agent-feedback/vite && npm run build -w @agent-feedback/next && npm run build -w @agent-feedback/cli
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
